tableDescription: Stores company master data for customers, partners, or business entities in the system.

columnDescriptions.company_id: Unique numeric identifier for each company record.
columnDescriptions.company_name: Full registered name of the business entity.
columnDescriptions.unified_social_credit_code: Official Chinese national business registration identifier.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the company record was initially created.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the company record was last modified.

tableDescription: Stores company financial statement amounts across periods, sourced from Excel reports.

columnDescriptions.amount_id: Unique identifier for each financial amount record
columnDescriptions.company_id: Foreign key referencing the company dimension
columnDescriptions.item_id: Foreign key referencing the financial item dimension
columnDescriptions.report_period: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, e.g., 202605
columnDescriptions.fiscal_month: Fiscal month within the fiscal year
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Type of financial statement: balance sheet, income, or cash flow
columnDescriptions.amount_type: Amount category such as begin/end balance, monthly, or YTD
columnDescriptions.quarter_no: Quarter number, zero if not quarterly data
columnDescriptions.amount: Monetary amount in the specified currency, NULL if not reported
columnDescriptions.currency: Currency code of the monetary amount
columnDescriptions.source_file_name: Original Excel file name for traceability
columnDescriptions.source_sheet_name: Original Excel worksheet name for traceability
columnDescriptions.source_cell: Original Excel cell location for traceability
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was created
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last updated

tableDescription: Cash flow statement line items with period and amount details by company.

columnDescriptions.公司名称: Name of the reporting company entity
columnDescriptions.报表日期: Statement date as of period end
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display order preserving original report sequence
columnDescriptions.行次: Line number as shown in source financial statement
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Name of the cash flow line item

tableDescription: Detailed balance sheet line items for companies, including period, section, and amounts.

columnDescriptions.报表日期: Exact date of the financial statement.
columnDescriptions.项目归属: Statement section: assets, liabilities, equity, income, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display order following the original report row sequence.
columnDescriptions.行次: Original line number from the source financial report.
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Name of the specific balance sheet line item.
columnDescriptions.期末余额: Balance amount at the end of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.年初余额: Balance amount at the beginning of the year.

tableDescription: Supermarket order line items with customer, product, geography, sales metrics, and data lineage fields.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Auto-incrementing surrogate primary key for each line item record.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business identifier grouping line items under the same customer order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Calendar date when the order was shipped to the customer.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping service level selected for delivery.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique identifier assigned to the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full display name of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment classification of the customer such as consumer or business.
columnDescriptions.city: Destination city of the shipment address.
columnDescriptions.province: Destination province or autonomous region of the shipment.
columnDescriptions.region: Macro geographic region grouping within the country.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier of the purchased product.
columnDescriptions.category: Top-level product category such as office supplies or furniture.
columnDescriptions.sub_category: More granular product classification within the category.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Descriptive name of the purchased product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Revenue amount for the line item before discount.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of units purchased on the line item.
columnDescriptions.discount: Fractional discount rate applied to the line item.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit earned on the line item after costs.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal or ZIP code of the shipment destination.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Originating data source platform supplying the record.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Path of the source file from which the record was ingested.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Original row number of the record in the source file.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier of the ingestion batch that loaded the record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields for change detection.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag indicating whether the record is active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: East China superstore sales orders with customer, product, and shipment details.

columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Original worksheet name in source file

tableDescription: Maps each sales region to its responsible regional manager with ingestion audit fields.

columnDescriptions.regional_manager: Full name of the manager responsible for the region.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position in the source file.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier of the ingestion batch run.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.
